title: Fiscal Years
subtitle: Annual accounting period management
selectExercise: Select a fiscal year to view its statistics
exerciseClosed: This fiscal year is closed. Accounting entries cannot be created or modified.
willCreate: The fiscal year will be created with:
yearExists: A fiscal year already exists for that year
closeConfirm: When closing the fiscal year, accounting entries cannot be created or modified for this period. Do you want to continue?
reopenConfirm: When reopening the fiscal year, accounting entries can be created and modified again. Do you want to continue?
deleteConfirm: The fiscal year will be deleted. Only fiscal years without associated entries can be deleted. Do you want to continue?
